newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes two by lethal injection.
newsitem.headline: China executes two by lethal injection.

text.p: Two Chinese criminals have been executed by lethal injection, the first time China has used the method as an alternative to the firing squad, the Xinmin Evening News said on Wednesday.
The executions were ordered by the Kunming Intermediate People's Court, in southwestern Yunnan province, under changes to the criminal law introduced on January 1 this year, the newspaper said.
Lethal injection was a more humane method of execution and conformed to international practice, it said.
Previously, all executions were by firing squad, it said.
It gave no details on the crimes or the executed people.
